_note: Finvia feature ideas, split into table-stakes (must_have) that every comparable app already offers, and differentiators (great_to_have) that put Finvia above the rest. Source for competitive context: BankTrack roundups covering Banktrack, Fintonic, Wallet, Money Manager, Spendee, Monefy, YNAB, Toshl, Mint, Goodbudget.

must_have._description: Baseline features users expect from any expense/finance app. Non-negotiable foundation; Finvia must do these cleanly.
must_have.data-import-export: Import and export all app data to CSV and JSON files.
must_have.google-sheets-export: Export data to a connected Google Sheet.
must_have.category-tracking: Track expenses and income by category and visualize them with clear charts and graphs.
must_have.auto-categorization: Automatic categorization of income and expenses (food, transport, leisure, rent, etc.).
must_have.simple-rules: Simple automatic rules to categorize transactions (e.g. merchant X -> category Y).
must_have.budgets-by-category: Budgets per category with alerts when nearing or exceeding the limit.
must_have.month-comparison: Month-over-month comparison per category (e.g. 'you spent 120 EUR more on dining than last month').
must_have.duplicate-fee-alerts: Alerts for duplicate charges, bank fees and unusual movements.
must_have.spend-trend-tracking: Track spending trends over time: see whether a category is rising or falling month over month.
must_have.savings-goals: Savings goals: e.g. 'save 400 EUR/month' or 'save 8,000 EUR by year-end', with progress trackers.
must_have.multi-currency: Multi-currency support with a base currency for reporting.
must_have.shared-budgets: Shared / household budgets for couples or family.
must_have.dashboard-reports: Customizable dashboard and reports for a clear overview of finances.
must_have.bilingual: Full bilingual ES/EN from day one, with locale-aware number, date and currency formatting.
must_have.security: Bank-grade security: encryption, 2FA, and privacy-first data handling.

great_to_have._description: Differentiators that go beyond what competitor apps offer. This is where Finvia wins: turning data into guidance and action.
great_to_have.natural-language-trends: Natural-language trend narratives: instead of only a chart, a weekly plain-language insight, e.g. 'Dining has been rising for 3 months (+35% this quarter); at this pace you'll end the year ~480 EUR over.'
great_to_have.category-trend-score: Per-category trend score (direction semaphore): an up/down/flat indicator per category showing where spending is heading, giving early warning before a budget is blown.
great_to_have.money-leak-finder: Money-leak finder: automatically group 'ant expenses', forgotten subscriptions and bank fees into a single 'recoverable per month' figure, directly answering 'my money disappears and I don't know where'.
great_to_have.cash-flow-forecast: Cash-flow forecast with a 'safe-to-spend today' number, projecting end-of-month and end-of-year balance from recurring income, fixed costs and average variable spend.
great_to_have.ai-goal-suggestions: AI-driven goal coaching: read real data and recommend concrete cuts ('save 5% on hobbies, groceries or loans') to reach goals faster.
great_to_have.what-if-simulator: What-if simulator: 'If I cut dining by 20%, I reach my 8,000 EUR goal 6 weeks earlier', with sliders tied to real goals.
great_to_have.auto-suggested-budgets: Auto-suggested budgets from history: propose realistic per-category budgets based on a 3-month average adjusted for seasonality, with one-tap accept.
great_to_have.subscription-radar: Recurring and subscription radar: detect recurring charges, flag price increases and forgotten subscriptions, and surface total monthly recurring spend.
great_to_have.anomaly-detection: Anomaly and duplicate detection: alert on unusual spikes, possible duplicates, or a category running hot vs. its baseline.
great_to_have.confidence-categorization: Auto-categorization with a confidence score that learns from your past corrections via one-tap 'fix and remember'.
great_to_have.seasonal-comparison: Smart seasonal comparison: compare each category against the same month last year (Dec vs. Dec), not only the previous month.
great_to_have.weekly-digest: Weekly and monthly money digest: an auto-generated summary (top categories, vs. last period, biggest expense, savings rate) in-app and optionally by email.
great_to_have.savings-rate-hero: Savings rate as the hero metric, surfaced prominently as the single best financial-health indicator.
great_to_have.net-worth-tracking: Net worth tracking over time: combine accounts, cash and manual assets/liabilities into a single trend line.
great_to_have.multichannel-alerts: Configurable multi-channel alerts: choose the channel per alert type (push, email) for low balance, duplicate charges, fees, budget limits and unusual activity.
great_to_have.receipt-capture: Receipt capture and attach: snap a photo, OCR the amount and merchant, and attach it to the transaction.
great_to_have.privacy-first-mode: Privacy-first / local-first mode: option to keep data on-device and self-export anytime, as a key differentiator vs. cloud-only competitors.

top_picks_to_stand_out: natural-language-trends + category-trend-score + money-leak-finder (the core differentiator: tells users what's happening and what to do)
